AccessProfile.description:
One access profile: a named binding of scopes to concrete facade
operations and record types, reviewed deployment policy
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 10.1).

id.description: The access profile name a caller identity is granted.

operations.description: The profile operation ids the profile may call, unique (CFG-ID-6).

recordTypes.description: The record types the profile may touch, unique (CFG-ID-6).

scopes.description: The OIDC scopes the profile admits, unique (CFG-ID-6).

Binding.description:
One binding of a concrete contract operation to a route
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 7): one concrete operation per
(profile operation, record type) pair, with the static worst-case
upstream-call budget the checks hold the route to.

filters.description:
The declared fields of the bound record type a search binding
filters on (`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 8.11.1); the
facade offers exactly these as typed equality query parameters.
Every entry must name a declared field, checked at the project
checks; the list is unique (CFG-ID-6).

maximumUpstreamCalls.description:
The declared budget of upstream sends per exchange; the static
worst-case count must stay within it.

operation.description: The profile operation this binding serves.

recordType.description: The record type the concrete operation serves.

route.description: The route the operation dispatches to.

Digest.description: A SHA-256 digest: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex digits.

ExternalId.description: An identifier another system issues, written exactly as its issuer gives it.

LocalId.description: A local identifier: a lowercase letter, then up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.

PinnedRef.description:
A pinned reference to a profile or pack: plain identifier plus the
version and digest `adapterctl check` verifies (CFG-ID-4,
`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 6).

digest.description: The digest the artifact's bytes must hash to.

ProjectIdentity.description:
The project identity block: the deployment's own name and version
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 10.1). The id is a local
identifier (CFG-ID-1); the version is text, the same version-as-text
rule as profiles and packs.

RecordField.description:
One declared record field, typed under CFG-VAL-9 so fixture values and
route outputs are checked against it.

required.description: Whether every record of the type carries the field.

RecordType.description:
One declared record type and its fields
(`products/adapter/CONCEPT.md` section 6).

fields.description: The declared fields, unique by whole item.

name.description: The record type name, the `{type}` of concrete operations.

TemplatedRoute.description:
A template instantiation in a project, Camel's `templatedRoute`
(`manual/route-template.html`). Placeholders resolve at instantiation,
during `adapterctl check` and at startup, never per request.

parameters.description:
Parameter value by parameter name; each key is a local identifier,
the template parameter it instantiates (CFG-ID-1).

routeId.description: The instantiated route id; its `from` becomes `direct:<routeId>`.

routeTemplate.description: The pack template this instantiation references.

description:
The adapter project artifact (`AdapterProject`): the declared record
model, the pinned profile and pack references, the template
instantiations, the bindings, and the access profiles.

bindings.description: The bindings of contract operations to routes.

parameterizedParts.description:
The deployment's value for each of the profile's parameterized
parts, keyed by part name. The engine writes each value over the
response-envelope members of that name; every declared part needs
a value and no value names an undeclared part.

recordTypes.description: The declared record types and fields.
